Namaskar Friends,
In this video, we explore the latest ground update of Package-03 of the Raipur–Visakhapatnam Highway (NH-130CD) in Chhattisgarh. This is one of the most challenging sections of the entire corridor because of the massive 2.8 Km long Twin Tunnel, multiple viaducts, animal underpasses, hill cutting zones, and the last interchange of Chhattisgarh.
In this update, you will see:
• Twin Tunnel Portal-1 & Portal-2 Area
• Massive Viaduct Cum Animal Underpasses
• Hill Cutting & Earthwork Progress
• Black Top / Asphalt Work
• Crash Barrier Installation
